requirement_results.command: a valid corpus with declared field types and resolved cross-resource references compiles deterministically, verified via the sealed verify_deterministic_build oracle
a resource missing the field_types key, or missing a type declaration for one of its own fields, is rejected with TYPE_ERROR
a field declaring a type name outside the closed type grammar is rejected with UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY
a field value that does not satisfy its own declared type -- including a boolean value against a declared integer type -- is rejected with TYPE_ERROR
a resource declaring more than one distinct execution owner is rejected with MULTIPLE_EXECUTION_OWNERS; a single owner repeated is accepted as unambiguous
a resource referencing another resource not compiled in the same request is rejected with UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE
direct and longer reference cycles are rejected with CONSTRAINT_ERROR; a legitimate non-cyclic diamond reference graph compiles successfully
genuinely malformed YAML is rejected with SOURCE_INVALID
a declared id mismatch is rejected with CONSTRAINT_ERROR
a rejected compilation never returns any CanonicalIrRelease object, partial or otherwise
full local pytest regression, no new failures versus the pre-existing sandbox baseline

comparing a release with itself is IDENTICAL with a stable content-addressed digest; comparing two distinct releases in reverse order yields a different digest, since the diff is directional (added vs removed)
a candidate release with an added, a removed and a changed resource relative to its predecessor produces a distinct structural diff digest

identical releases classify IDENTICAL; a pure resource addition classifies COMPATIBLE; a resource removal, a field's type declaration being removed, and an existing field's declared type changing all classify BREAKING
a migration plan is deterministic (repeated calls produce byte-identical plans, including their own plan_digest) and content-addressed; a differently-shaped candidate produces a different plan_digest
generate() produces a single release-manifest ArtifactManifestEntry whose digest is a real content-addressed SHA-256 URN over the release's own resource identities
a BREAKING candidate cannot reach generate_governed() without an explicit, non-empty governed migration plan -- the negative acceptance criterion, made executable
a BREAKING candidate accompanied by its own real, non-empty migration plan (produced by RetainedMigrationPlanner) reaches generation successfully
a COMPATIBLE candidate reaches generation even with no migration plan at all
a blocked BREAKING generation attempt (even with a migration plan present but empty of steps) never returns any artifact list, partial or otherwise

full local pytest regression, no new failures versus the pre-existing sandbox baseline (the two known interpreter-pin failures are unrelated and pre-existing; a transient Fuseki OOM was diagnosed and resolved by restarting only that service, confirmed unrelated to this task's own changes)
IdentityBackedAuthority satisfies the sealed AuthorityResolutionPort Protocol
RegistrationAndMarkingPolicy satisfies the sealed PolicyDecisionPort Protocol
NamedQueryGateway satisfies the sealed NamedQueryPort Protocol
a registered contract+version, an identified principal, and a resource authorized under the real marking join together reach the real TypeDB projection read and return a served response
an unregistered contract_id is denied (ARBITRARY_QUERY_FORBIDDEN) with no response of any kind ever returned
a registered contract_id at an unregistered version is denied identically to an unregistered contract, with no response
a principal never registered in the real IdentityRegistry abstains (IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS) with no response of any kind ever returned
a resource outside the requester's real marking clearance is denied with the SAME reason code as an unregistered contract (ARBITRARY_QUERY_FORBIDDEN) and the real TypeDB projection is never reached
a resource deliberately missing its classification triple in the real Fuseki marking join is denied, never disclosed, at any clearance
a request whose classification_marking_ref has no registered clearance mapping is denied, never defaulting to permit
a registered query naming no resource parameter reaches the real TypeDB projection without a marking check
a missing purpose is rejected by the sealed GovernedContext constructor before any gateway or backend call is ever made
an arbitrary, non-allow-listed contract_id shape is rejected by the sealed NamedQueryRequest constructor before any gateway or backend call is ever made
a real, lower-blast-radius network fault (a genuine closed local TCP port) inside the marking-authorization port propagates as a real OSError and is never silently absorbed into a PERMIT decision
full local pytest regression with a real live PostgreSQL DSN set, no new failures versus the pre-existing sandbox baseline
